overclaims: These records weigh against an imminent funding stop, but do not falsify an undated claim that support will eventually dry up.
checks.note: Excerpt, criteria, axis, open horizon, unresolved outcome and citations all check out. The problem is the rationale. e1 records only that SoftBank paid its third and final committed tranche on 2026-10-01. It says nothing about money after that. e2 covers cloud access, not credits, and gives no funding information. So the evidence cannot support any claim about the near-term outlook, and 'weigh against an imminent funding stop' goes beyond it. Smaller point: the proposition says the funding drying up is what raises the survival questions. The source says the two factors do, made worse when funding dries up.

Excerpt is verbatim. 'Putting it at risk' is a fair reading of 'I fear for'. The Q2 2024 target period and the definition of resources are disclosed as evaluator choices. The rationale correctly treats e4's year-end annualized projection as unable to settle the comparison. The limitations match the packet: the original pages returned 403, and the S-1 gives only full-year figures. e4's excerpt, publisher and dates are correct. Historical_observation axis, not_applicable horizon and unresolved outcome match the agreed reviews.
